title: Locally Explaining Prediction Behavior via Gradual Interventions and Measuring Property Gradients

bias_targets.methodology: Gradually intervening on the semantic property of fur color (e.g., light to dark) using text-guided image-to-image editing models and measuring the expected property gradient magnitude to quantify the impact on cat vs. dog classification.

Synthetically blending segmented colorful patches (spurious surgical/artifact markings) into unbiased skin lesion images and measuring the resulting expected property gradient magnitude to assess the classifier's reliance on these patches.

bias_targets.target: Spurious feature bias (Hair color vs. Age)
bias_targets.methodology: Gradually intervening on hair color (transitioning to gray/white) using image editing models and tracking the expected property gradient magnitude across training epochs to evaluate its effect on 'young' vs. 'old' predictions in facial images.

Intervening on the physical and virtual orientation of 3D objects (e.g., rotating along x, y, z axes) and evaluating changes in cosine similarities in a CLIP model's latent space to measure the drop in zero-shot classification performance for uncommon viewpoints.
